# [TASK] ADR: natural-language query architecture & cross-service aggregation

## Task
Write an ADR for the natural-language query architecture: how a free-text
query becomes a structured filter and how that filter gets executed across
services without a cross-service DB join (ADR-002).

## Scope
Decide, don't just describe: (a) which service does NL extraction — ai-service,
reusing its existing Ollama integration, is the working assumption; (b) which
service (or gateway layer) aggregates person/role/collaborator data
(actor-service) with catalog data (movie-service) into one result set; (c) the
structured filter shape both the extractor and the aggregator agree on.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] ADR file added under `docs/architecture/adr/`, numbered after the current highest ADR
- [x] Documents the structured filter shape (person, role, yearFrom/yearTo, collaborators[], genre, negations[])
- [x] Documents which service aggregates across movie-service and actor-service, and why, consistent with ADR-002
- [x] Reviewed against `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` for consistency before Tasks #2/#3 of this Story start

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3
